explanation: I found no single Mathlib, Batteries or core lemma that states this. The closest are `Int.eq_of_mod_eq_of_natAbs_sub_lt_natAbs` (Mathlib/Data/Int/Basic.lean), `Nat.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt` (natural numbers only), and `Int.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_nonneg_of_lt` (also in Mathlib/Data/Int/Basic.lean). The first has the hypothesis `a % b = c`, not `(b - c) % k = 0`, so it doesn't apply directly. The second is `Nat.ModEq` only. The third needs `0 ≤ m` and `m < n`, so it can't take the difference `b - c`, which may be negative. The only Int-specific route I found rewrites with `Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero` and then with `Int.emod_eq_of_lt` twice. That combines two separate lemmas, so I didn't count it as a one-declaration special case. Mathlib has no `Int.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt`. I searched with greps for `eq_of_lt_of_lt`, `eq_of_.*ModEq`, `eq_of_.*emod` and `emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero`.
